notes: Swinging across a city and dropping into street fights is Action, and Parkour Traversal is the preset written for exactly this - a traversal city with brawls in it - so both the preset and its shape are taken as offered. traversal-city is the shape word for word: rooftops and ledges sized for a moving player with the streets below as the fallback route, which is also where the crimes happen, and its P2 is earned because the swing arcs and rooftops genuinely overhang the street level. I kept cover-los and choke-bottleneck for the parked cars and alleys the street fights need, and dropped hazard-kill because ring-out edges would make falling lethal when this city wants the street as a safe landing. Added spawner-npc for the muggings and robberies that appear and have to be stopped, npc-population for the civilians a street crime needs, and settlement-density for the author's few comic-book city blocks. With no user to ask I took the crimes as small repeatable street encounters rather than set pieces, as the author asked, and recorded the stated 20-storey maximum building height here since the option list has nowhere to carry a number.
